author: JJTheGuy
body:
Hey everyone! It's JJ here, some of you know me for being the noob who likes walls, or that my brother is _garrett_rocks_. Whatever floats your boat. Now we have decided to make a few maps, and I need templates if there are any. We can't figure out the whole void thing, so any help is good.

The templates we need are: 
1) Walls
2) Nebula
3) Capture the Hill

Any help you can offer is great! I may need some more large scale help after I get one sid eon the walls done, or just builders. Thanks for everything!

                               -JJ

replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
the walls template i use

for nebula you can just start with a bedrock platform in a void map and build from there using worldedit, vanilla, mcedit or whatever, im pretty sure its the same for CTH. others should correct me if im wrong, this is just how i've done it in the past

replies.body: You don't really need a template for Nebula since you can decide what the team sizes should be. You should make it a nice size that works well with the player count you will give it. Go by instinct I guess
